notes: Editorial review on the owner's instruction; the owner decided the app will have no scholarly reviewer. Expanded profile (2026-11-23): lineage, birth and first marriage to Khunays ibn Hudhafah; Umar's offer to Uthman and Abu Bakr (Bukhari 4005) and the marriage in 3 AH; worship; knowledge and narrations (Bukhari 1566 quoted, Bukhari 618, Muslim 2496, Abu Dawud 3887); the suhuf of the Qur'an (Bukhari 4986-4987, Uthman's message quoted); Umar's waqf and will; death. The "sawwamah qawwamah" description is marked reported: al-Dhahabi gives it from Uqbah ibn Amir with the remark "isnaduhu salih" (Siyar 2/228-229), and Ibn Sa'd has it mursal from Qays ibn Zayd, Qatadah and Ibn Sirin; Abu Dawud 2283 (divorce and return) is cited without a grading, since the app records gradings only from the collections' authors. Death kept as a disputed 41-45 range, with a disputeNote (41, Abu Ma'shar/al-Dhahabi; 45, al-Waqidi); the outlier date of 27 reported by Ibn Abd al-Barr from al-Dulabi is left out. The episode of the two wives in Surat al-Tahrim is left out. Second expansion (2026-11-23, to full-biography length), each addition checked against its source before writing: al-Dhahabi's opening words "al-sitr al-rafi'" (Siyar 2/227, reported); Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab's comment "fa-khara Allahu lahuma jami'an" (Ibn Sa'd 8/67, reported); her question was in the Farewell Hajj (Bukhari 4398, Muslim 1229); Ibn Umar learning the two rak'ahs before Fajr from her (Bukhari 1180); the Prophet's sitting voluntary prayer in his last year (Muslim 733); the five animals that may be killed, quoted verbatim from Bukhari 1828 and graded sahih by al-Bukhari's inclusion (Muslim 1200 cited for the parallel); the army swallowed at al-Bayda', via Abdullah ibn Safwan (Muslim 2883); Umar's prayer for martyrdom in Madinah (Bukhari 1890), marked reported because her own hearing of it is given by al-Bukhari only as a ta'liq ("nahwahu"); her will to Abdullah also covering a sadaqah of hers and land she endowed at al-Ghabah (al-Istiab 4/1812); Marwan carrying her bier from Dar Bani Hazm to Dar al-Mughirah and staying at al-Baqi' until the burial (Ibn Sa'd 8/68-69 from al-Waqidi, Siyar 2/230), reported. Considered and left out: Marwan asking for the suhuf after her death (not found in the editions of Ibn Sa'd, Siyar or al-Istiab used here), the honey and Surat al-Tahrim episode, Qays ibn Zayd's report of her weeping at the divorce, the 'sawahib Yusuf' and camel-swap reports, and Abu Dawud/Tirmidhi narrations graded only by later scholars. Book locators were checked against the OpenITI digital transcriptions of the editions named in sources.json (Ibn Hisham, al-Saqqa ed.; Ibn Sa'd, Ata ed.; Siyar, Risala ed.; al-Istiab, al-Bajawi ed.), reading the page markers as page ends; only pages actually seen are cited. Every hadith citation was compared with its text in the pinned hadith-api dataset (content/hadith), and quoted hadith wording is verbatim from it. Not checked: chains of transmission beyond what the cited authors state, and page locators against printed copies. Done by Claude, an AI model, for the app's editors, after source checking. This is an editorial review, not the approval of a qualified scholar.
